title: Papercut record v1
description: One JSON object per line in a papercuts ledger JSONL file. NOTE: ledger rows written before the `type`/`resolves`/`status`/`fix_url` fields were added lack `type` entirely and are grandfathered as type=papercut by every consumer.
$comment: READER CONTRACT (binds every consumer of ledger/spool records, present and future). Validation is a WRITER-side gate: `additionalProperties: false` applies only to the gate's own records at append time. Readers MUST ignore unknown fields. A consumer that dispatches on `type` MUST skip records with unknown `type` values rather than erroring (papercut_open.py does); a structural consumer MUST pass them through (papercut_flush_group.py groups any JSON object with a valid `ts`). Quarantine is structural only — unparseable lines, parseable non-objects, or an invalid `ts` — never vocabulary-based. A whole-ledger validator must be a separate audit command, never a read-path gate. COMPATIBILITY CONTRACT (for changes to this schema): adding an optional field is safe — readers already tolerate it; removing or renaming an existing base field is breaking and requires coordination across every install reading the ledger; changing the structure of an existing field is a new field plus a deprecation of the old one, never an in-place edit. EXTENSION POINT: a ledger repo may carry its own schema copy extending this one with team-specific optional fields; the shipped gate keeps validating against the shipped schema only, so capture stays offline and clone-less.
